title: Simulation code for "Agentic Service Markets Across the Computing Continuum: A Polymatroidal Architecture"
description: R + targets pipeline reproducing the experiments of the arXiv preprint arXiv:2603.05614, "Agentic Service Markets Across the Computing Continuum: A Polymatroidal Architecture". It runs an agentic service market on a node-level dependency substrate (a tree, the tree plus one crossing arc, and a laminar parallel fan) at a testbed-calibrated congestion level, and measures that a crossing in the leaf-block family costs allocative exactness and truthfulness while clearing prices exist on totally unimodular families, that an integrator's inner exposure restores exactness at a volume cost, and that laminarity does not order price stability. Reference optima, truth-assuming planners and cross-domain mechanisms (the discovered-price market and arrival-order and deadline-priority posted prices) are compared on held-out seeds, beside a crossing sweep, a contention sweep of joint misreports, a measured LLM agent workload and a container testbed that replays the market's allocations. Reproduce all results with targets::tar_make().
